# Beantage Specialty Coffee Roasters

> Beantage offers two specialty coffee experiences in Bogotá, Colombia: a private cupping and a walking coffee tour through three coffee shops. Whoever buys the experience receives the book "Specialty Coffee: From Seed to Cup" by Luis Felipe Ariza Vesga as a gift; chapter 1 is free. Booking is by WhatsApp (+57 313 398 0338); groups of 4 to 8 get 20% off. The site is in Spanish (default) and English.

## Español

- [Inicio](https://beantagecoffee.com/): la casa de Beantage y un recorrido visual por el mundo del café de especialidad.
- [La experiencia](https://beantagecoffee.com/experiencia/): cata privada y recorrido de café en Bogotá, cómo reservar y descuento para grupos.
- [El libro](https://beantagecoffee.com/libro/): "Café de especialidad: de la semilla a la taza", libro de regalo con capítulo 1 gratis.
- [Preguntas frecuentes](https://beantagecoffee.com/preguntas/): reserva, idiomas, descuento, libro y qué es el café de especialidad.

## English

- [Home](https://beantagecoffee.com/en/): Beantage and a visual tour of specialty coffee.
- [The experience](https://beantagecoffee.com/en/experience/): private cupping and coffee tour in Bogotá, how to book, group discount.
- [The book](https://beantagecoffee.com/en/book/): "Specialty Coffee: From Seed to Cup", the gift book with a free chapter 1.
- [FAQ](https://beantagecoffee.com/en/faq/): booking, languages, discount, the book and what specialty coffee is.
